---
title: "Rigid Pavements"
---

This section focuses on Jointed Concrete Pavement (JPC) response, load transfer, slab rocking, curling and warping, moving and dynamic loads, Traffic Speed Deflectometer (TSD) response, composite pavements, finite-element modeling, and analytical beam formulations.

## Articles & Technical Notes

### RIGID-01 — What Does a TSD See When It Crosses a Concrete Pavement Joint?

[Read RIGID-01: Analytical Finite Beam Model](../posts/rigid-analytical-finite-beam/index.qmd)

An analytical beam-on-Winkler-foundation model for jointed concrete pavements, exploring prescribed load-transfer efficiencies, multiple joints, slab length, multi-tire loading, deflection-velocity signatures, and sensitivity to boundary conditions. Includes five animation topics drawn from the author's 2025 FWDUG presentation.

Additional rigid-pavement articles and computational studies will be added as this research series develops.
